plugins.name: job-fetch
plugins.description: Fetch + ingest a job description past a proxy-blocked host (Claude Code web egress allowlist), via ATS public APIs and a remote-exec MCP (Composio) fallback. Auto-fires on job URLs via a UserPromptSubmit hook; ingest-and-acknowledge, no JD echoed back.

plugins.name: book-clubs
plugins.description: Book-club lookup for Claude (from kindle.schlacter.me): name or describe a club → get it plus its recent monthly picks. A bundled, keyless stdio MCP server — 32-club catalog with typo-tolerant name/celebrity matching + Book Notification pick fetching, and a generic scraper fallback for off-catalog clubs Claude web-searches for.
